data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021 were GBP 15.424m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows favourable development on prior years (primarily the 2019 underwriting year) of approximately GBP 1.99m (a release), with no specific named catastrophic events or regulatory changes cited as drivers. The syndicate's business is written as Medical Malpractice.
raw_causal_phrases: The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.
Judgement is used to assess the extent to which past trends may not apply in the future.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was not stated explicitly as a gross movement in narrative or a dedicated 'movement in prior years' note. The prior year movement was calculated from the gross claims development table (triangle) by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2021 and 2020) and comparing the 2019 column's Current estimate to its previous diagonal. All source amounts in the report are presented in GBP '000. exact_reserve_text is blank because no single sentence describing the gross prior-year movement was found. 'Medical Malpractice' was mapped to the standard Lloyd's 'Professional Lines' for LOB movement reporting.
